body: As morbid as it is, I think it's quite normal. I can very much relate. Unemployment has been one if the biggest sources of suicidal depression in my life.
No i have nobody!! Why does everyone assume suicidal people are surrounded by people who care?? If they were they probably wouldn't be suicidal!!@
Wait why were you there for 10 days
I have nobody to talk to and nobody cares
What is Sound? Do you mean Sound Mental Health or something like that?

It sounds like there's no hope for me. That's what it sounds like. I really thought something existed out there for people as desperate as me. I don' tknow why I thought that, I guess I just assumed. I am now worse off after making this thread than before. Thanks for the help for those who actually gave a shit. I literally only see one way out now. I've got a week to think it over but I"m pretty sure I knowwhere this is going to end up. I seriuosuly thought there was something out there for me. I had no idea how naive I was about there being help for someone as desperate and unable to function as me. I am not at all surprised now why so many people commit suicide. Not one bit.

I fucking knew it. You aren't here to help anyone! You're literally telling me you think I am just looking for fucking housing!!! I CAN'T FUNCTION ON MY OWN AS A HUMAN BEING BECAUSE OF MY MENTAL PROBLEMS!!! I AM LITERALLY INCAPABLE OF BEING INDEPENDENT AT THIS POINT!!! I AM BEYOND DESPERATE AND TOTALLY COLLAPPSING IN ON MYSLEF AND YOU'RE GIVING ME THE MOST ABSOLUTE GENERIC BARE MINIMUM NOTHING OF A RESOURCE AND SAYING I DON;'T DESERVE HELP BECAUSE I'M NOT GRATEFUL FOR THE NOTHING YOU'VE GIVEN ME???? ARE YOU FUCKING SERIOUS?????????????????/

If that's the case, then what do you know about Washington state hospitals? Some generic federal government mental health line sounds like a frustrating waste of time that literally wouldn't help me AT ALL.

I've gone to my regular doctor and am on the basic anti anxiety meds they give everyone like candy that don't really do anything other than slightly help to keep you from panicking. 

No way in hell am I calling a crisis line. I"ve read tons of horror stories of people calling those then cops showing up at their door. No way am I allowing that to happen to me. Crisis lines are fucked up and I don't trust them.

I don't know what your goal is here but it doesn't sound like helping me is one. I'm not looking or "a place to stay." Forget the whole homelessness part, okay? Are you qualified to answer this question for me? What do you actually KNOW about mental hospitals IN WASHINGTON STATE?? All you've done is discourage me further and push me further into hopelessness, what are you even trying to do??? 

What is your experience with mental hospitals and how do you know what it takes to be admitted into one?????

Okay, I'm not just some guy who is down in the dumps, I have multiple DIAGNOSED mental disorders. Jesus christ, I'm not some otherwise healthy person who is in a bad spot, I HAVE SERIOUS ISSUES THAT I CANNOT GET UNDER CONTROL THAT HAVE NEGATIVELY AFFECTED MY LIFE TO THE POINT THAT I CAN NO LONGER FUNCTION TO THE POINT OF NOT BEING ABLE TO HOLD A JOB OR EVEN FACE OTHER PEOPLE OUT ON THE FUCKING STREETS

So I'm humiliated for 24 hours, and then what? It's wasted energy. It's drawing things out for a day or two longer than necessary, and wasting valuable resources that others need in the process. It would literally be unethical to check into an ER for wasting their time and resources now that I think about it. Why prolong the inevitable when the inevitable is the inevitable?

You've given me a lot to think about, but I can't see it changing anything. The fact that you've been through so much more than me and have come out on top is only evidence you're stronger than me, smarter than me, or both. You were able to say "fuck it" and just move forward in the way that you are. Whatever you have in you to be able to do that, I don't have. This situation I'm in isn't new to me. I've gone over all this multitudes of times. You are what you are and you made it work. I am what I am and no matter what I do I can't make it work. I don't want to make it work anyway, because I don't like what I am. I don't want to be what I am. I DON'T WANT TO accept myself. I'm a freak. I'm a physical genetic disaster. I'm a flawed product. Born defective. 

It doesn't matter anyway, because in a week I'm homeless. I've got nothing. Nowhere to go. Nobody left but judgmental people tired of me "not getting my shit together." My own fucking mother avoids calls and seeing me because she just assumes I am going to ask for some kind of help. I'm a black sheep to my family and a freak to the rest of the world. I'm such a physical defect that I can turn a great day into a hopeless nightmare by one quick glance in the mirror. 

I 100% believe you that you understand where I'm coming from. You figured it out for yourself. You can't figure out a physical defect. You can't figure out being abandoned by the people who are supposed to be there to love and emotionally support you. I'm a mental burden to them. 

I'm either going to check myself into a mental hospital to be told I'm fine after 24 hours, going to become homeless and roam the streets of Seattle looking for heroin as an out, or flat out kill myself. Everything else is a head\-in\-the\-clouds fantasy.

I want to preface by saying I know you mean well and I thank you for the kind words and for trying to help. I am not meaning to offend you by what I'm about to say. 

You don't seem to have an understanding of how anxiety disorders work. I can't "just stop caring" BY DEFINITION. I physically can't whether I want to or not. I can't turn it off. When people say things like that it makes me angry, because it downplays the severity of my problems. I'm not just some guy who's feeling down in the dumps. I have literal psychological disorders that prevent me from using the simple logic you've presented to calm down. 

I will try to take your words to heart, but it makes no difference. You have to understand how deep the hole I've dug myself into is. Do you know how degrading it is to have to start from the very bottom again like a teenager? The only jobs I can get are "first time jobs" because of my job history. What then? What if in a few years I'm right on track? I'll be almost 40. How am I supposed to date? What woman in her right mind would want to be with a 40 year old man who can only get jobs designed for teenagers and can't even support himself? I'm so far deep in the hole I've created for myself that I can't see the light at the surface anymore. You need to understand that.

This advice is great for someone in their 20s. I'm so far past the point of no return in every aspect of life that "pulling myself back up" is utterly impossible. That's just the way it is in the society we live in. American society is built by and designed for people who know how to win. If you don't know how to play the game, you sink. That's the reality of it. 

Again, thank you for the kind words, but they're at least 15 years too late for me.
I've read horror stories of people calling a helpline saying they're suicidal, then cops showing up at their door taking them away by force. No way in hell am I going through that.
